Scheme.Description: Synchronizes formed TONUSDT ROC(20) momentum with the BTCUSDT close-to-SMA(20) trend every four hours, trades only BTCUSDT long or flat with an eight-decision cooldown, and protects entries with a 2% target and 2.5% stop.
